### NAME

`grype` - Anchore Grype — vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
curl -sSfL https://get.anchore.io/grype | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin
```

```
# container image
grype alpine:latest

# directory
grype ./my-project
```
